# GA4 Optimizer

> GA4 Optimizer is a free browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) that adds missing features to the Google Analytics 4 interface — A/B test analysis, date range presets, exit pages, sticky headers, and 14 more tools. A companion extension, GA4 Live Debugger, provides real-time hit inspection, dataLayer monitoring, and tracking validation. Both are 100% local with zero data collection.

## Products

- [GA4 Optimizer Overview](https://www.gaoptimizer.com/): Free Chrome/Edge/Firefox extension that adds 18+ missing features to Google Analytics 4
- [GA4 Optimizer Features](https://www.gaoptimizer.com/features/): Full list of all features — A/B test significance, date presets, sticky headers, exit pages, advanced filters, annotations, column totals, 500-row reports, and more
- [GA4 Optimizer Documentation](https://www.gaoptimizer.com/documentation/): Setup guides, keyboard shortcuts, configuration, and troubleshooting for every feature
- [GA4 Live Debugger](https://www.gaoptimizer.com/ga4-debugger/): Free GA4 debugger extension for Chrome/Edge — real-time hit feed, dataLayer monitoring, consent decoding, sGTM routing detection, block mode, and export
- [GA4 Live Debugger Documentation](https://www.gaoptimizer.com/ga4-live-debugger-documentation/): Full usage guide covering hit inspection, DataLayer correlation, diagnostics, Block Mode, Data Dictionary, team sync, and troubleshooting

## Install Links

- [Chrome Web Store - GA4 Optimizer](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ga4-optimizer/hlldjkhoepkephgaeifgbelgchncfnjj): Main extension for GA4 interface enhancements
- [Chrome Web Store - GA4 Live Debugger](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/akkagamamkhledgmhlljcdiodkgeeiob): Companion debugger extension
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/ga4-optimizer-analysis-t/ejokbgelaaegbgemjjhgppigoclanomh): GA4 Optimizer for Edge
- [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/ga4-optimizer/): GA4 Optimizer for Firefox
